sql: select (select max(started_at)::text from bot_runs) as last_boot, (select count(*) from bot_runs where started_at > now() - interval '2 hours') as boots_2h, (select count(*) from mmsell_candidate_ticks where captured_at > now() - interval '1 hour') as cands_1h, (select count(*) from mmsell_candidate_ticks where captured_at > now() - interval '3 hours') as cands_3h, (select max(captured_at)::text from mmsell_candidate_ticks) as last_candidate, (select count(*) from paper_trades where created_at > now() - interval '1 hour') as paper_1h, (select max(created_at)::text from paper_trades) as last_paper_trade, now()::text as now_utc
